输入受邀邮箱，我们会发送一次性登录链接。: Enter your invited email and we will send you a one-time Magic Link.
如果该邮箱已被邀请加入平台，你会收到一封含登录链接的邮件。: If this email has been invited to the platform, you will receive an email with a Magic Link.
平台仅限受邀成员使用，不开放注册。: The platform is invite-only and does not offer sign-up.
不勾的那类接口，这把 Key 调用时返回 403。: Calls to unchecked API types with this key return 403.
范围外的定义，点查、目录与导出都不会出现。: Definitions outside the scope never appear in lookups, the catalog or exports.
提交后这把 Key 的下一个请求即按新范围。: The very next request with this key uses the new scope.
每把 Key 还有数据范围：范围外的标签、指标不会出现在目录与点查里；范围外的快: Every key also has a data scope: tags and metrics outside the scope never appear in the catalog or lookups; snapshots outside the scope return 404 (same as non-existent); an export whose conditions use an out-of-scope tag returns 400. The scope is set when the key is created and can be changed any time from the key list with "Change scope"; the next request uses the new scope.
确定删除沙箱表「{name}」？分享会一并撤销，湖里的数据随后清理。: Delete sandbox table "{name}"? Its shares will be revoked and its data in the lake cleaned up afterwards.
